name: Walk the tutorial tree from its reset row

setup.note: The second setup key reaches a3, our reset point.

notes.note: Each action starts again from this row.

actions.label: Move up twice
actions.caption: k k moves up two rows. Return toward the beginning while keeping the same reset point.

actions.label: Move down twice
actions.caption: j j moves down two rows from a3. Compare the opposite motion from exactly the same starting row.
